title: Earnings management, lawsuits, and stock-for-stock acquirers’ market performance

rival_explanations: the accruals-lawsuit association reflects ex-post performance rather than earnings management having an independent, first-order effect
reverse causality - the merger announcement return itself drives the likelihood of a lawsuit, rather than the market anticipating lawsuits
pre-merger abnormal accruals (accrual reversal) drive the long-term underperformance (Louis, 2004a)
reverse causality - market performance is itself a determinant of lawsuits, so a lawsuit-performance association need not mean lawsuits cause underperformance
